sunny.name: Sunny
sunny.description: Sunny weather has no special effects.

breezy-with-cherry-blossoms.name: Breezy with Cherry Blossoms
breezy-with-cherry-blossoms.description: This form of windy weather only happens during the Spring. Pink flower petals fall through the air during this weather, and (if other conditions are met) the legendary Spring fish will spawn.

breezy-with-falling-leaves.name: Breezy with Falling Leaves
breezy-with-falling-leaves.description: This form of windy weather only happens during the Fall. Leaves fall through the air during this weather, and (if other conditions are met) the legendary Fall fish will spawn.

rain.name: Rain
rain.description: In rainy weather, all crops on the farm are automatically watered.

rainy.name: Rainy
rainy.description: In rainy weather, all crops on the farm are automatically watered.
